general.note: WUE makes this one of the cheapest real options on the list (~$33k net), 3.5 hrs from Sacramento, and UNR has its own MD school with early-assurance pathways for its undergrads.
general.medNote: Smaller pond = easier access to labs and physician shadowing. Grad-rate stat drags from part-time students.

program.name: Professions in Medicine (PiM) + Assured Seat
program.req: CORRECTED: no numeric criteria published anywhere official. (UNR’s separate “Post-Baccalaureate Pathway” is for people who already hold a degree — not this program.)
program.note: The WUE-price undergrad stands on its own regardless.

programVerified.src: https://med.unr.edu/education/medical-education/pim-certificate — CORRECTION: the real undergrad route is the Honors "PiM + Assured Seat" track (sophomore entry, interview-based); UNR’s "Post-Baccalaureate Pathway" is for people who already hold a degree and is not this. No numbers published for either.
